% Fixture: failures/err-runaway-argument
%
% Purpose: verify that an unclosed brace (runaway argument) is reported.
%
% Expected maketex behaviour:
%   - Engine: pdflatex -halt-on-error
%   - Exit: 1 (fatal error)
%   - No PDF produced
%
% Log error (exact text):
%   ! File ended while scanning use of \textbf .
%   <inserted text>
%                   \par
%   <*> main.tex
%
% This error is harder to localise than a simple undefined command because
% TeX only discovers the unclosed brace at end-of-file; the error surfacing
% system must walk back from the EOF marker to report the opening brace site.
%
% The error surfacing system should extract:
%   - type:    error
%   - message: File ended while scanning use of \textbf
%
% Note: TeX does not report the original line number of the unclosed brace
% in batchmode — it reports end-of-file. This is a known limitation.

\documentclass{article}

\begin{document}

This is valid content.

\textbf{This opening brace is never closed — TeX will run off the end of the file.

\end{document}
